# Amazon Location runtime and broader records

**Status: proposed.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Implement device-position ingestion, retrieval/history and tracker consumer associations with explicit runtime semantics.

## Proposed scope

- [ ] BatchUpdateDevicePosition
- [ ] GetDevicePosition
- [ ] BatchGetDevicePosition
- [ ] GetDevicePositionHistory
- [ ] ListDevicePositions and position filtering/evaluation
- [ ] AssociateTrackerConsumer, DisassociateTrackerConsumer and ListTrackerConsumers
- [ ] RequestBasedUsage/deprecated PricingPlan metadata compatibility decision (a pricing value, not an API)
- [ ] Geofences and location-event delivery
- [ ] KMS and geospatial-query eligibility
- [ ] Maps, search, places, routes and other Location data planes

## Integration decisions

Tracker configuration CRUD and tags are implemented records only. See the [records guide](../../guides/location-records.md). PositionFiltering metadata does not imply filtered device positions or event delivery.
